context: Patronage: a union widow at the kafeneio.

lines.speaker: npc.kafeneio_widow
lines.text: Kyrie Varelas. My husband cut for you twelve years. The pension is small.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: This month and next. Tell nobody. Especially Kallis.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: I'll talk to the union. And the bank. And God.

lines.speaker: npc.kafeneio_widow
lines.text: In Kastoria we say: a promise is a coat with no lining.
